Changes for future years are not excluded. ** No trading but settlement is open if the holiday is not on a Saturday or Sunday . Please note that on Xetra and Frankfurt in the year 2026 regular stock exchange trading takes place on the following public holidays: Ascension Day (14 May 2026) Whit Monday (25 May 2026) Corpus Christi (4 June 2026) Trading of shares and Exchange traded products on Frankfurt and Xetra ends on public holidays (Germany and State of Hesse) where trading takes place according to the FWB trading calendar at 20:00 CET. Deviating from this, structured products are traded until 22:00 CET on these days. On December 30, 2026, deviating trading hours may apply. In this case, a circular with the relevant data for the last trading day of the year (final trading session of the year) will be published.
